During their [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Langoonan]] species native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Langoona]], in a [[Langoona system/Legends|system of the same name]] deep in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], unsuccessfully '''rebelled''' against their masters. Prior to the rebellion the Langoonans had been considered a favored slave species by the Hutts, but after their defeat they were stripped of technology and driven to the brink of extinction. The small population that did survive was maintained by the Hutts for use in safaris.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lagoonan rebellion was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EA" />
